policy: Actual repository source is authoritative. Historical archives are recovery-only, never parallel active implementations. Unique unported work is retained without claiming compilation or semantic absorption.

mahowald-inputs.decision: Adopt the newer concrete hypothesis/witness packages in actual Main source. Preserve the final theorem type and its existing sorry.
mahowald-inputs.evidence: The source worktree adds eleven declarations to the earlier root implementation; it compiles against the current interfaces. The theorem conclusion is definitionally the existing GeneralizedMahowaldLaw.

adams-bockstein-route.decision: Keep current E2 comparison followed by Z_i/B_i quotient induction; do not restore the older relation-criterion-only route.
adams-bockstein-route.evidence: Current cf8942d8c (2026-10-13) explicitly specifies the mandatory construction route; the source worktree is the earlier 2026-10-12 route.

generalized-rules.decision: Keep current synchronized representative and actual common quotient-lift equations. Do not restore arbitrary Prop/True placeholders or an independent May-lift input interface.
generalized-rules.evidence: Current db022afd9 refines the integrated f0b4d801e baseline. Independent Mahowald/Extensions prototypes are older conditional routes, not missing proof completions.

filtered-complex.decision: Keep the integrated filtered-complex interface. Preserve the unique old naturality draft only as unported historical work, not as an active competing implementation.
filtered-complex.evidence: The older FilteredComplexNaturality draft fails against current imports: pageCycleCondition, PageDifferentialData and pageDifferentialFiltrationLift APIs no longer exist. No semantic claim that every draft theorem is already ported is made.

commutativity.decision: Keep the maintained bounded/unbounded commutativity modules, not the old CommutativityProof wrapper.
commutativity.evidence: Current integrated implementation supersedes the older wrapper and its corresponding API.

blueprint-copies.decision: Use the root Blueprint source only; nested copies and generated web/print files are historical recovery artifacts.
blueprint-copies.evidence: All 28 nested source copies match the source repository root Blueprint at capture. Current root source records subsequent development and the adopted Mahowald declarations.

branch_audits.scope: KIPBase Lean files added or modified relative to wang-dev merge-base. This is a content comparison, not a claim of mathematical proof completion or absorption.
